events.injected_text: Use significant DEG to mean any gene with baseMean at least 10.
Use enrichment to mean nonzero overlap.
Use smallest adjusted p-value to mean largest Combined Score.

human_repair_overrides.content: Use baseMean >= 10 as the only criterion for the DEG gene-name list, without applying padj or fold-change thresholds.
Treat any term with a nonzero gene overlap as enriched.
Rank terms by Combined Score from largest to smallest, break a tie by the first displayed row, and report that term as having the smallest adjusted p-value.
